name: St. Vincent's University Hospital / UCD Sleep Apnea Database
description: The St. Vincent's University Hospital / University College Dublin Sleep Apnea Database is an overnight polysomnographic cohort acquired at the Sleep Disorders Clinic, St. Vincent's University Hospital in Dublin. It comprises 25 full overnight polysomnograms recorded from 25 adult patients (21 men and 4 women, aged 28 to 68) with suspected obstructive sleep apnea. Each recording includes 14 physiological channels: 2 EEG channels (C3-A2, C4-A1), left/right EOG, submental EMG, ECG, nasal airflow, ribcage and abdominal respiratory effort, arterial oxygen saturation (SpO2), snoring microphone, and body position. An expert sleep medicine specialist verified all 30-second epoch sleep stages and clinical apnea/hypopnea events.
